newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wine sales continue trend growth.
newsitem.headline: Australian wine sales continue trend growth.

text.p: Domestic sales of Australian wine continued their trend growth in March, despite a seasonally adjusted 1.0 percent fall to 29.1 million litres, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
The trend estimate increased 1.2 percent in March and has shown continuous growth since November 1995.
Exports of Australian wine increased 13.6 percent by volume in March to 12.4 million litres from 10.9 million litres and rose 8.5 percent in value to A$48.0 million from A$44.3 million.
Imports increased 17.5 percent in volume to 911,000 litres from 775,000 litres and rose 5.5 percent in value to A$4.3 million from A$4.1 million, the bureau said.
